name: Tougijou no Reijou Erina
source:
Erina, an arrogant and prideful countess.
Despite her skills, which once earned her the title of knight commander—
She’s falsely accused of a crime, exiled from her homeland, and reduced to slavery.  
The one who buys her is none other than her former subordinate.

Now a slave, Erina clings to the pride of her noble upbringing.
Until she repays the price paid for her, her days as a slave will continue.
To escape her bondage as quickly as possible, she decides to become a female gladiator, earning prize money by fighting in the arena.

What harsh fate awaits the former countess, Erina?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160434.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
艾莉娜是一位傲慢而自负的伯爵千金。

她曾凭借实力获得骑士团长的称号，却被诬陷犯罪，流放出国，沦为奴隶。

买下她的人，竟然是她过去的部下。

成为奴隶后，艾莉娜仍紧紧守护着贵族的自尊。在偿还对方为她支付的价格之前，她的奴隶生活不会结束。为了尽快摆脱束缚，她决定成为女斗士，在竞技场战斗赚取奖金。

前伯爵千金艾莉娜将迎来怎样残酷的命运？！
